e.title: Peak3 AI in Insurance 指南
e.summary: Peak3：保险 AI 执行指南——Agentic AI/LLM/ML 全景
e.body:
Peak3「AI in Insurance: An Executive Guide to Agentic AI, LLMs and Machine Learning」：保险 AI 的执行级指南——智能体 AI/大模型/机器学习在保险的应用全景。对 RIAA：保险 AI 的系统性指南——与 [[ai-agents-for-insurance-guide]]（智能体目录）、[[insurance-support-agent]]（智能体实现）配套：指南（概念）+ 目录（产品）+ 实现（代码）；理解「Agentic AI/LLM/ML」三者在保险的定位；保险 AI 入门的体系化材料。

## 同类工具
[[aws-audit-manager-insurance-chatbot]]、[[genre-genai-actuarial-framework]]、[[intact-ai-leadership]]

e.body_en:
Peak3 'AI in Insurance: An Executive Guide to Agentic AI, LLMs and Machine Learning': an executive-level guide of insurance AI — the application panorama of agentic AI/LLMs/ML in insurance. For RIAA: a systematic guide of insurance AI — with [[ai-agents-for-insurance-guide]] (agent directory) and [[insurance-support-agent]] (agent implementation) it forms guide (concepts) + directory (products) + implementation (code); understand the positioning of 'agentic AI/LLM/ML' in insurance; systematic material for entering insurance AI.
